review.why: Handles code review feedback with verification and reasoned pushback instead of automatic agreement or blind implementation.
review.summary: A response pattern: read all feedback, restate it, verify against the codebase, evaluate, respond technically, implement one item at a time with tests. It bans performative replies, says to stop and ask when any item is unclear, treats a partner's feedback as trusted but external reviewers' as checkable, and includes a YAGNI check for suggestions to implement properly.
strengths: Do not implement anything until every unclear item is clarified
Different handling for the owner's feedback and for external reviewers
YAGNI check: search for real usage before adding polish
cautions: Bans some phrases by name, which reflects one author's style
Later sections were not read in full
Assumes access to the codebase being reviewed
